title: AutoDrive used-car record (car.json)
description: One file per car. Written by the extract step (Claude reads Jitty's WhatsApp message + photos) or by hand. Everything downstream — the website listing, the two Instagram story frames, the links — is generated from this. Never invent a value: leave it null and the generators will cope.

slug.description: Short id. Becomes #car-<slug> on the page and images/<slug>/. Must be unique on the site — if a slug exists, add the year: polo18.

campaign.description: utm_campaign for story links, e.g. golf-2017. Default: <slug>-<year>.

make.description: Full make as shown on the listing, e.g. Volkswagen.

make_short.description: Short form for stories and the WhatsApp text, e.g. VW. Default: make.

model.description: Model + variant as one string, e.g. Golf R-Line Wagon.

body.description: Hatch, Sedan, Wagon, SUV, Ute, Van…

built.description: Build date as on the compliance plate, e.g. Jun 2017. Null if unknown.

km.description: Odometer reading, exact if the odometer photo shows it.

price_note.description: Small line under the price: Drive-away price · Firm, no offers · Firm price. Null = nothing.

engine.description: e.g. 1.4L petrol, TSI turbo petrol, 2.0 diesel.

trust.description: Up to three green tick lines after the automatic 'Workshop-inspected': the car's best features.

description.description: The listing paragraph, 60–110 words, plain English, no hype. The PPSR / repaired disclosure sentences are added automatically — do not write them here.

ppsr_listed.description: True if the car is on the PPSR register. Adds the standard disclosure line.

repaired.description: True if it has been professionally repaired (write-off history). Adds the standard disclosure line.

rego_months.description: Months of rego included. Drives the '3 months rego' story chip.

file.description: Filename inside the car's folder (the orchestrator renames to <slug>-NN.jpg for the site).

alt.description: 3–8 words describing the shot: 'front angle', 'odometer showing 62,937 km', 'engine bay'.

role.description: What the shot is. hero = front three-quarter, the one that leads the listing and the story. Used to order the collage.
